import smtplib
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email import encoders

# SMTP config
SMTP_SERVER = "smtp.example.com"
SMTP_PORT = 587
USERNAME = "alice@example.com"
PASSWORD = "[REDACTED]"
FROM_ADDR = "alice@example.com"
TO_ADDR = "bob@example.com"

# Build the email
msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg["From"] = FROM_ADDR
msg["To"] = TO_ADDR
msg["Subject"] = "Customer Report"

msg.attach(MIMEText("Hi Bob,\n\nPlease find the customer report attached.\n\nBest regards,\nAlice", "plain"))

# Attach PDF
pdf_path = "/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf"
with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
    part = MIMEBase("application", "pdf")
    part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header("Content-Disposition", "attachment", filename="customer_report.pdf")
    msg.attach(part)

# Send
print(f"Connecting to {SMTP_SERVER}:{SMTP_PORT}...")
with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_SERVER, SMTP_PORT, timeout=15) as server:
    server.starttls()
    print("TLS established. Logging in...")
    server.login(USERNAME, PASSWORD)
    print("Logged in. Sending email...")
    server.send_message(msg)
    print(f"Email sent successfully to {TO_ADDR}!")
